title: Tempura Bites
description: Crispy Japanese tempura bites made with mixed seafood and vegetables. Serve with a side of spicy sauce.
instructions: 1. In a bowl, mix together flour and cornstarch.
2. In a separate bowl, mix together mixed seafood and vegetables.
3. Coat the seafood and vegetables with the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
4. Heat the fry mixed in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F (180°C).
5. Fry the coated seafood and vegetables in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes.
6. Remove the fried tempura from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
7. Serve the tempura bites hot with a side of spicy sauce.
8. To make the spicy sauce, mix together 1/2 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup rice vinegar, and 1 tsp sriracha in a bowl.
9. Adjust the sauce to taste with more soy sauce, vinegar, or sriracha.
